pages.text: Kakeru! I'll help you whenever you find a question mark.
pages.runtime_text:
Kakeru! I'll help at
any question marks.

pages.text: Listen carefully! I'll give you some important advice.
The lab's battery won't last long. We need to find another source of energy soon.
pages.runtime_text:
Lab batteries drain
fast. Find energy
somewhere soon!

pages.text: Don't worry! When the lab rides on a monkey's head, it can draw energy from the monkey's Pipo Helmet.
pages.runtime_text:
Ride a monkey's head
to recharge the lab
from its helmet.

pages.text: Get close to a monkey and press {BUTTON_TRIANGLE} to ride it.
Once you're riding a monkey, use the directional buttons or analog stick to move.
pages.runtime_text:
Ride a monkey. Move
with the D-pad or
analog stick.

pages.text: Press {BUTTON_CROSS} while riding a monkey to jump.
Press {BUTTON_CROSS} again in midair to perform a double jump.
Press twice without rushing. A double jump can reach higher places.
pages.runtime_text:
Press twice calmly.
Double jumps reach
higher places.

pages.text: Touch a question mark to hear the advice again. Remember that!
pages.runtime_text:
Touch a question
mark to hear the
advice again.

pages.text: If you stay in the lab alone, its battery keeps draining. You'll be unable to move when it runs out, so be careful!
pages.runtime_text:
The lab alone drains
its battery. Empty?
You can't move!

pages.text: Try pressing {BUTTON_SQUARE} or {BUTTON_CIRCLE} while riding a monkey. You can perform all sorts of actions!
pages.runtime_text:
Ride a monkey, then
try {BUTTON_SQUARE} or {BUTTON_CIRCLE} for
different actions!

pages.text: You can press {BUTTON_TRIANGLE} even while controlling a monkey to switch to another one.
pages.runtime_text:
While riding, press
{BUTTON_TRIANGLE} to switch to
another monkey.

pages.text: Find different monkeys and try them out!
Kakeru, see the banana icon at the top left of the screen?
pages.runtime_text:
Kakeru, see the
banana icon at the
top left?

pages.text: That shows this monkey's health.
When an enemy attacks you, you lose bananas.
If you lose them all, you'll be sent back to the lab alone. Be careful!
pages.runtime_text:
Lose every banana
and you're sent back
to the lab alone!

pages.text: Pick up bananas in the stage to restore your monkey's health.
pages.runtime_text:
Pick up bananas to
restore your
monkey's health.

pages.text: Until you're used to the controls, try touching every blue question mark you find.
pages.runtime_text:
New to the controls?
Touch blue question
marks for advice.

pages.text: Look, Kakeru! There's a strong-looking monkey over there.
pages.runtime_text:
Look, Kakeru! That
monkey looks strong!

pages.text: It looks like it can throw a powerful punch. Getting hit would really hurt!
pages.runtime_text:
It throws powerful
punches. Getting hit
would really hurt!

pages.text: If you catch that monkey, its powerful punches might shake trees too.
pages.runtime_text:
Catch it! Its strong
punches might shake
trees too.

pages.text: It's locked.
There should be a key somewhere. Could someone be carrying it?
pages.runtime_text:
There's a key
somewhere. Does
someone have it?

pages.text: Wow, that's a high cliff! An ordinary monkey probably couldn't climb that.
pages.runtime_text:
What a high cliff!
An ordinary monkey
couldn't climb it.

pages.text: Could you use the stump in front of the cliff as a stepping stone?
pages.runtime_text:
Use that stump as a
step to climb the
cliff?

pages.text: Or perhaps there's a monkey nearby that could leap up the cliff in one jump...
pages.runtime_text:
Is a monkey nearby
that could leap up
the cliff at once?

pages.text: There's a monkey trying to hide among the branches.
It's obvious to us, but it might fool other monkeys.
Look, Kakeru! That's a warp device the monkeys use.
That warp device might take us to Specter. We could clear this stage too!
pages.runtime_text:
Warp to Specter? We
might clear this
stage too!

pages.text: Get close to the warp device and press {BUTTON_TRIANGLE} to use it. Give it a try!
pages.runtime_text:
Get near the warp
device and press {BUTTON_TRIANGLE}.
Try it!

pages.text: That monkey looks like a mermaid.
It looks like this monkey could swim in the water.
There's a pond ahead.
Ordinary monkeys don't seem able to swim. They drown if they enter the water!
pages.runtime_text:
Ordinary monkeys
can't swim. They
drown in water!

pages.text: You could cross on the leaves, but they look like they'll sink quickly.
pages.runtime_text:
Cross on the leaves?
Careful! They seem
to sink quickly.

pages.text: Is there a way to cross them quickly?
Look at that branch. Unlike the others, it has some kind of mark on it.
pages.runtime_text:
Look at that branch.
Unlike the others,
it has a mark.

pages.text: Could you use that branch and a nearby monkey to get across?
pages.runtime_text:
Use that branch and
a nearby monkey to
get across?

pages.text: A monkey with a paraglider is stuck in a tree.
If you ride that monkey, you should be able to fly a long way.
pages.runtime_text:
Ride that monkey to
fly a long way!

pages.text: Could you find a way to get it down from the tree?
We want to get across, but a normal jump won't be enough.
pages.runtime_text:
We need to cross,
but a normal jump
isn't enough.

pages.text: Is there a monkey that could fly a long way?
While flying with a paraglider, press {BUTTON_SQUARE} to flap its wings.
Use those flaps wisely if you want to fly farther.
That monkey is carrying a torch.
Swing the torch near a fire and it should light up.
Swing the lit torch to set other things on fire too.
This door is closed, but it doesn't seem to open with a key. How can we open it?
pages.runtime_text:
The door is closed.
A key won't work.
How can we open it?

pages.text: I think the pattern on the door is related to something in this room...
pages.runtime_text:
The door's pattern
seems linked to
something here...

pages.text: There's a windmill here.
I think using that windmill will let us move on.
You'll need to make some wind to turn it.
That floor switch looks like it can be pressed from above. Could you put that big stone on it?
pages.runtime_text:
Press the switch
from above. Put that
big stone on it?

pages.text: Try hitting the big stone. You might be able to move it.
Is that monkey riding a bike? Look closely: it only looks that way.
pages.runtime_text:
A monkey on a bike?
Look closely: it
only looks that way.

pages.text: It runs fast, though! It seems able to dash and ram things too.
pages.runtime_text:
It runs fast! It can
also dash and ram
things.

pages.text: I can see a switch in the distance, but we can't reach it normally.
pages.runtime_text:
That distant switch
is out of normal
reach.

pages.text: A monkey with a long-range attack might be able to press that switch.
pages.runtime_text:
A monkey's ranged
attack might press
that switch.

pages.text: This monkey is dressed as a lizard.
It can jump onto a wall, cling to it, and move along it.
It seems able to cling to walls marked with lizard footprints.
pages.runtime_text:
It can cling to
walls with lizard
footprints.

pages.text: There's something like a switch on the floor, but stepping on it doesn't work.
pages.runtime_text:
That floor switch
won't work if you
just step on it.

pages.text: Maybe a powerful impact would activate it?
Wow! That monkey is breathing fire! It's like a street performer.
pages.runtime_text:
It breathes fire!
Like a street
performer!

pages.text: If you catch that monkey, you could attack with fire and burn things too!
pages.runtime_text:
Catch it to attack
with fire and burn
things too!

pages.text: This looks like a pedestal for a stone statue.
Are you supposed to stand on it and do something?
There's a statue striking a pose in front of us...
That monkey looks like a mummy.
It moves slowly, but guns and arrows don't seem to hurt it.
pages.runtime_text:
It moves slowly, but
guns and arrows
can't hurt it.

pages.text: Since it's a mummy, perhaps it's weak against fire?
That monkey sprays cold gas.
Its gas could turn water into ice in an instant.
There's a pond, but we'd drown if we went straight in.
If the pond were frozen, we could walk across the ice...
pages.runtime_text:
Freeze the pond and
we could walk across
the ice...

pages.text: A monkey holding control handles can board a Monkey Loader.
pages.runtime_text:
A monkey with
control handles can
board a Loader.

pages.text: Let's ride the Monkey Loader from here.
Move the monkey close to the Monkey Loader and jump to board it.
pages.runtime_text:
Get close to the
Monkey Loader and
jump to board it.

pages.text: Once aboard, use the directional buttons or analog stick to move.
pages.runtime_text:
Move the Loader with
the D-pad or
analog stick.

pages.text: The Monkey Loader doesn't seem able to jump.
Pressing {BUTTON_CROSS} makes the monkey get off instead of jumping. Be careful!
pages.runtime_text:
Press {BUTTON_CROSS} to get off.
It won't jump!
Be careful!

pages.text: This monkey can fire missiles.
The missiles seem to chase their targets.
It's troublesome as an enemy, but useful if you can ride it!
It looks like something should be inserted into this hole.
pages.runtime_text:
Something should be
inserted into this
hole.

pages.text: Is there a monkey carrying something that could fit in this hole?
pages.runtime_text:
Is a monkey carrying
something that fits
in this hole?

pages.text: That monkey is carrying an electric fan.
An electric fan should make stronger wind than a hand fan.
pages.runtime_text:
Electric fans make
stronger wind than
a hand fan.

pages.text: That monkey has wings on its back.
It looks like it could jump and keep flying through the air.
pages.runtime_text:
It could jump and
keep flying through
the air.

pages.text: That monkey is inside a pumpkin. Why is it dressed like that?
pages.runtime_text:
A monkey inside a
pumpkin! Why is it
dressed like that?

pages.text: It seems able to hide completely inside the pumpkin.
There's an unlit candle.
Lighting it might make something start moving.
The control handles this monkey carries let it board the nearby UFO and fly.
pages.runtime_text:
Those control
handles let it board
a UFO and fly.

pages.text: Use the directional buttons or analog stick to move the UFO, just like a monkey.
pages.runtime_text:
Move the UFO with
the D-pad or analog
stick, like monkeys.

pages.text: Like other vehicles, you can press {BUTTON_CROSS} to get out of the UFO.
I can see the monkeys' warp device far away. How can we get over there?
pages.runtime_text:
The monkeys' warp
device is far away.
How can we reach it?

pages.text: If we can't get to it, it would help if it came closer to us...
pages.runtime_text:
If we can't reach
it, could it come
closer to us?

pages.text: There's a switch, but it keeps popping in and out.
Why not hit it from above when it pops out?
This monkey seems able to send electricity through the rods in its hands.
pages.runtime_text:
That monkey's rods
can conduct
electricity.

pages.text: Electricity might get those idle machines working.
That monkey has a rocket on its back. The rocket's thrust lets it fly high up.
pages.runtime_text:
A rocket on its
back lets that
monkey fly high!

pages.text: If you can ride it, you might reach higher places!
That monkey fires heart beams.
A heart beam will confuse you and make it hard to move properly. Be careful!
pages.runtime_text:
Heart beams confuse
you, making movement
hard. Be careful!

pages.text: There's a monkey walking on the wall. It seems to have a device on its feet.
pages.runtime_text:
A monkey walks walls
with a device
on its feet.

pages.text: If you catch that monkey, you should be able to climb that wall.
pages.runtime_text:
Catch that monkey
and we could climb
that wall.

pages.text: There's a worn-out door, but it's too old to open normally.
pages.runtime_text:
That worn-out door
is too old to open
normally.

pages.text: It's falling apart, so perhaps you could find a way to break it?
pages.runtime_text:
It's falling apart.
Perhaps you can
break it?

pages.text: We can't move on until we break that obstacle.
The ground ahead is frozen and very slippery.
You also won't be able to jump very far there.
Keep it up!
Looking good!
You did it!
I let my guard down... I never expected the whole lab to be shrunk!
pages.runtime_text:
I let my guard down.
Even the lab got
shrunk!

pages.text: Until we're back to normal size, we'll have to make do with this lab.
pages.runtime_text:
Until we're normal
size again, this lab
will have to do.

pages.text: Don't worry. We have everything we need.
There are all sorts of facilities here. Why not take a look around?
pages.runtime_text:
There are lots of
facilities here.
Take a look around!

pages.text: That's the warp device.
It lets you warp the entire lab to another location.
We can use it to rescue the Professor and the others, and find Specter too.
pages.runtime_text:
We can rescue the
Professor and find
Specter with it!

pages.text: I hope we can return to our normal size soon.
I'm counting on you, Kakeru!
That's the data device.
Use it to save and load your data.
Save often so you don't lose your hard-earned progress.
pages.runtime_text:
Save often to keep
your hard-earned
progress safe.

pages.text: That's the Monkey Book.
It records data on the monkeys you've caught during your adventure.
pages.runtime_text:
It records data on
the monkeys you've
caught.

pages.text: The monkeys you caught in the last stage should be recorded there too.
pages.runtime_text:
The monkeys from
the last stage
should be there too.

pages.text: Why not take a look?
That's the Enemy Book.
It records the War Borg photos you've collected from the shop.
pages.runtime_text:
It keeps War Borg
photos collected
from the shop.

pages.text: That's the Movie Box.
It stores the movies you've collected from the shop.
That's the Music Box.
It stores the songs you've collected from the shop.
You can listen to your favorite songs whenever you like.
That's the illustration collection.
These pictures were drawn while making this game.
When you buy them at the shop, they're stored here.
That's the Capsule Shop.
It sells music, movies, illustrations, and all sorts of other things.
pages.runtime_text:
It sells music,
movies, artwork and
all sorts of things.

pages.text: You can buy them with chips collected during the game.
Collect lots of chips and buy plenty of items!
You can't shop right now because you don't have any chips.
pages.runtime_text:
You have no chips,
so you can't shop
right now.

pages.text: That's Monkey Photo.
You can photograph monkeys you've caught and turn the pictures into cards.
pages.runtime_text:
Photograph captured
monkeys and make
cards from them.

pages.text: Those cards are used in Gachi King.
Make your favorite cards and give Gachi King a try!
That's your monkey album.
It stores the cards you make in Monkey Photo.
Make lots of different cards and build an album of your own!
pages.runtime_text:
Make different cards
and build your very
own album!

pages.text: You can play the Gachi King minigame here.
You can play against the computer on your own.
You can also use wireless communication to play with friends.
pages.runtime_text:
Use wireless play
to play together
with your friends.

pages.text: Practice plenty so your friends won't beat you!
In the end, Red's only talent is brute strength.
Blue flirts with everyone. That's his problem.
Ha ha... Satoru had a rough time too.
A girl who throws tantrums won't be very popular.
He's a grandpa, so he shouldn't push himself too hard.
Collect all six Nano Cards and we can return to our normal size.
pages.runtime_text:
Collect six Nano
Cards to return to
our normal size.

pages.text: Only five left! Let's hurry and collect them!
We did it, Kakeru! We have all the Nano Cards! Now we can return to our normal size!
pages.runtime_text:
We did it, Kakeru!
All Nano Cards!
We can grow back!

pages.text: Don't you think it's about time to save?
You haven't visited the shop much, have you?
Saving chips is fine, but never spending them would be a waste!
pages.runtime_text:
Save chips if you
like, but not using
them is a waste!

pages.text: I'm glad you're playing so much, but remember to take a break sometimes.
pages.runtime_text:
Glad you're playing
so much! Remember to
take breaks too.

pages.text: The lab has run out of spare batteries.
Why not buy some batteries at the shop?
